goal: Prove opt-in Rust cuda-oxide compressor prefill, ratio-4 replay, and ratio-4 state-only orchestration, including optional FP8 compressed output, without claiming attention ownership.

cuda_oxide.module_form: executable-local #[cuda_module] with state initialization, row placement, libdevice-linked pooling, RMS, YARN RoPE, and optional FP8 output

covered_behavior: ds4_gpu_compressor_prefill_tensor general-ratio remainder and ratio-4 previous/remainder state placement
weighted RMS, RoPE, and optional FP8 processing of compressed output rows
excluded_behavior: attention decode, prefill, indexed, and output-Q8 kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, and C CUDA removal

rust_owned_in_this_stage: executable-local cuda-oxide compressor prefill orchestration launch proof
ratio-4 replay and ratio-4 state-only orchestration launch proof
state initialization, F16 APE, weighted RMS, YARN RoPE, and optional FP8 numeric validation
not_claimed_in_this_stage: attention decode, prefill, indexed, or output-Q8 kernels
runtime graph integration, default CUDA route, or C CUDA removal

b300_execution.test_command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 cargo test --locked -p ds4-cuda --features cuda-oxide-backend -- --nocapture
b300_execution.command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/rustc-codegen-cuda/target/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so CUDA_OXIDE_LLC=/usr/bin/llc CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1 cargo run --manifest-path /workspace/cuda-oxide/crates/cargo-oxide/Cargo.toml -- run --features cuda-oxide-kernels --bin ds4-cuda-compressor-prefill-orchestration-smoke
